name: India Home Loans Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, India Home Loan Ltd offers retail home loan products in the affordable housing segment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IHLL is a non-deposit-taking housing finance company registered with the National Housing Bank and qualifies for priority sector lending under RBI guidelines. It specializes in offering affordable loans to self-employed families, where traditional proof of income is not readily available, assessing repayment capacity based on cash flows. The company has a strong presence in Maharashtra and Gujarat and has recently expanded into Rajasthan, further strengthening its reach in the affordable housing finance segment.
